parser_invariance_control.required_behavior: Independent parsers/representations of the same published grid must agree within source precision before morphology metrics are allowed.

allowed_authority: coverage reconstruction subject to parser correctness

svp_rule.custodian_observation: Last SVP for relevant JR15001 raw line was updated about two days before and described as not very accurate.
svp_rule.required_model_behavior: Represent SVP recency/quality as an explicit uncertainty state; do not invent a numerical depth-error distribution from this email alone.

future_numeric_gate: If raw JR15001 .all bytes and the relevant corrected/compiled surface are simultaneously available, preregister a raw-to-processed residual comparison before inspecting target morphology.
reuse_policy: All JR15001/BAS/BODC materials listed here are calibration-only for multibeam processing V2.
